# Preserve Worker07’s resolved review findings in an immutable issue-linked ledger

The published Worker07 head `fbfa032435ea1c399ae9b98bfedadb9ed639430d` contains 18 resolved internal findings across four independent receipts. Its handoff only identifies three newly filed source/owner issues (MIM #1169, #1170 and CultureMech #672), plus older owner issues. The internal remediation lineage is not explicitly bound to a deduplicated issue/disposition ledger. This is the same kind of publication-accounting gap addressed for Worker01 in #1173; it does not undo the scientific corrections.

| Original finding | Scope | Immutable review |
|---|---|---|
| C-A-01 | Approximate KOH7.3g omitted from stock payloads though explicit in bothprimaryrecipes. Preserve approximate amount in notes, not as exact finalconcentration. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/captures/c-review-a-final.json` (`8fde04550a6a`) |
| C-A-02 | PARTIAL enum misused for unresolved chemicalIDs or unreported fullstock. COMPLETE means complete sourceconstituentlist; PARTIAL means explicitlyomitted additionalcomponents; UNKNOWN meanssource doesnot establishcompleteness. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/captures/c-review-a-final.json` (`8fde04550a6a`) |
| C-A-03 | Explicit independent conventionalnomenclature evidence needed for sodiumcitratedihydrate→trisodium before exactaliasaddition; no vendorassignment tosource. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/captures/c-review-a-final.json` (`8fde04550a6a`) |
| C-A-04 | Documentprimarypursuit and source-specific missingrequirements for all four sodiumborate sourcefamilies, notonly failedMediaDB288. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/captures/c-review-a-final.json` (`8fde04550a6a`) |
| C-A-05 | Recovered TOGO annotation is Sodium carbonate, not bicarbonate; author corrected this factual misstatement without changing ambiguity hold. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/captures/c-review-a-final.json` (`8fde04550a6a`) |
| A-REVIEW-B-91 | Frozen complete UTEX DAS recipe composition[3].evidence explicitly names Sigma V6629. Draft class-only rationale overlooks this exact supplier identity lead. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/parts/a-review-b-final.json` (`0f2b8233ce28`) |
| A-REVIEW-B-90 | Seven MediaDB sodium EDTA occurrences have only ontology evidence referenced; source-specific original references are present in frozen recipes and must be pursued independently. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/parts/a-review-b-final.json` (`0f2b8233ce28`) |
| A-REVIEW-B-116 | Seventeen sodium ammonium phosphate contexts link only one article DOI; confirm family applicability and pursue other distinct reference families from frozen recipes. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/parts/a-review-b-final.json` (`0f2b8233ce28`) |
| A-REVIEW-B-EVIDENCE-KINDS | Captured MediaDive /rest/compound/1118,291,2154,1732 return JSON status400 WrongCall; JCM665/688 return Nothing found. These were marked primary_source although they establish only access/source-availability limits. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/parts/a-review-b-final.json` (`0f2b8233ce28`) |
| A-REVIEW-B-STOCK-SCOPE | New JCM706 nominal-stock payload says0.05mL per10mL receiving medium; original JCM706 specifies per4.7mL. JCM1422 current primary4mL differs from frozen10mL. Inheritance text1463/1462 andM708/687 is copied across95/121/134 without per-case relevance. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/parts/a-review-b-final.json` (`0f2b8233ce28`) |
| B-C-01 | DSM1053 current source does not repeat ferric hydrate; correct source attribution. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/parts/b-independent-c-review-final.json` (`5dac5bf702ef`) |
| B-C-02 | PARTIAL completeness incorrectly justified by unresolved identities/solvent: use schema list completeness semantics. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/parts/b-independent-c-review-final.json` (`5dac5bf702ef`) |
| B-C-03 | RESTingredient response does not carry occurrence stock attributes; source locator must bind frozen source_record or matched original recipe. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/parts/b-independent-c-review-final.json` (`5dac5bf702ef`) |
| B-C-04 | Explicit nominal stock context permits bounded proposal; remaining percentage/solvent details need not defer source identity. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/parts/b-independent-c-review-final.json` (`5dac5bf702ef`) |
| INTEGRATION-01 | Verified same nine-input JCM900/JCM979 stock consolidated once, retaining both primary provenance sets, malformed molybdate string and approximate KOH quantity. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/captures/integration-review-final.json` (`fef705ca9f1d`) |
| INTEGRATION-02 | Validation receipt separately labels 2956 catalogue records and 2862 unique identifiers; prior mislabeled preliminary receipt retained. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/captures/integration-review-final.json` (`fef705ca9f1d`) |
| INTEGRATION-03 | Four concrete source-qualified nominal stocks and explicitly guarded decision deltas independently reviewed; missing form/solvent/percent details remain UNKNOWN. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/captures/integration-review-final.json` (`fef705ca9f1d`) |
| INTEGRATION-04 | Successor native wrapper records fifth confirmed Sodium_Malate DL-alias conflict while retaining source salt-stoichiometry uncertainty; initial review/finding preserved. | `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-07/captures/integration-review-final.json` (`fef705ca9f1d`) |

Please preserve all original reviews and payloads. Add a successor ledger linking every item to its issue, correction and exact independent re-review, with the prior artifact hashes. Reference that ledger from the active handoff. The scientific successor should retain the current 188-case/100-proposal content and the 17-occurrence #1203 correction. No owner application or approval follows.

Deduplication: the independent reviewer read all committed Worker07 report and native review additions, including their gitignored ancestor directories, and live #1169/#1170 bodies/comments. The coordinator verified the 18 review references against the exact published Git blobs, checked 679 current open and closed issue bodies, and searched the exact finding IDs. No existing issue covering this lineage gap was found in those checks.

Known source/owner issues and coordinator reconciliation requirements, including1203 and1210, remain separate.
title: Preserve Worker07 resolved review findings in an immutable issue-linked ledger
